amendments: B1: the final runner composes COMBINED_REQUIRED_CASES = A2_REQUIRED_CASES (A1 10 + A2M 12 + four A2-owned = 26) followed by B_REQUIRED_CASES (8) = 34 ids on one verified build/image lineage; the A1 harness fails on any missing, doubled or extra id. B node:test falsifiers include an omitted predecessor row, an omitted refusal row and an unexpected row.

B2 (fog-on setup): fog-off-controls, fog-on-socket-refused, fog-on-metadata-refused, fog-on-history-refused, fog-on-head-refused, fog-refusals-secret-free, fog-on-state-intact, fog-off-controls-after. A real fog-off match is played; the owned server is stopped; one stored match is flipped to fog-on by the registered offline fixture (the only write; stopped-PID guard, active fog-off match required, journal fingerprint before and after); the same image restarts. The capability is never mocked and no fog-on frame is delivered.

B3 (refusal contract, restated as literals, not imported from src): a fog-on participant (host, guest, spectator) gets exactly one Close {code AUTH_REJECTED, reason fog-projection-unavailable} and WS 1008 even after SessionJoin (lastSeq 0 and 1) and an Intent; a non-member gets the generic admission answer naming nothing; metadata 403 fixed for participants and 404 for non-participants; export and private-preview 500 fixed; timeline 200 audit rows only; /head 403 fixed for the host, generic 403 for others, 401 unauthenticated.

B4 (no secret): every received byte (sockets and HTTP bodies) is scanned for the captured public event ids and journal-head digest; a hit fails the run and would be a real B14 finding that stops the unit.

B5 (state and controls): a sibling fog-off match keeps delivering on the refusing process (fog-off-controls-after); after a second stop the stored lineage of both matches is unchanged except the one flipped field (fog-on-state-intact).
B6 (scope limits): the post-admission live refusal is a Jest pin and is not claimed from the built server; the unreadable-config path (WS 1011), public lobby summaries and S5-02 are not proved here.
B7 (done-test): the Step 3 done-test is the frozen argv in doneTestInvocation; the v220-steps.json flip rides the implementation PR as its last commit; Step 3 step-evidence rides the closure PR.

B8 (head control, found at first built contact): a default build does not journal a live match, so the host /head answers 404 {error: no head} both before and after an accepted action. The fog-off control accepts a digest (200) or exactly that 404, both past the auth and fog gates; the head digest is a sentinel only when present, and the sentinels are otherwise the public event ids (4 in the probe). The fog-on host /head is 403 with the fixed body, which differs from the 404 control, so the gate precedes the journal read.
B9 (unrun obligations): nothing in this admission is a built-image PASS; every owned row, the 26 inherited ids and the mutants are owed at RED/GREEN on the exact-main image.
